shared_elements: human or humanoid figure with raised arm(s)
figure shown in profile/frontal schematic with limbs extended
small round dot or disc element (A: cup mark; B: rosette-like circular motifs)
justification: Both surfaces depict an anthropomorphic figure with arms raised and include small circular elements, but that is the limit of the correspondence: A is a stick-figure beside a long undulating serpentine line and an isolated dot, while B is a heavily detailed winged human-headed being with elaborate feathered wings, beard, headdress, garment and a stylised plant with rosettes. The manner of depiction is also opposite in kind, A being minimally schematic linear outlines and B a densely modelled, richly patterned naturalistic figure, so nothing suggests a shared iconographic scheme.
